title: Zippers are way too small!
text: Zippers are way too small!. The fabric on the covers is okay -- the best you can expect for the price. However, on the covers I received they "cheaped" out on the zippers. They were substantially smaller than the actual size of the pillow so I had to literally stuff the pillow inside. The zipper did not break but I think I just lucked out.  Be aware, especially if you are purchasing covers for a larger sized pillow.
